thread:
sophie: FYI - NovaPayments opened a support ticket: sudden p95 latency spike on their Dedicated pool after last stable deploy. Sales flagged as P2. Copying details below — need triage.

maria: Support summary from customer chat: 'since 03:40 UTC, p95 went from ~220ms -> ~1.4s, errors ~0.2% but queueing increased'. Snippet from their logs: 
```
[2026-03-19T03:40:12Z] serve: req_id=9f3a queue_wait=120ms exec=1.2s cpu=95% model=redwood-7b-q4
[2026-03-19T03:41:05Z] serve: req_id=9f3b queue_wait=200ms exec=1.4s cpu=96% model=redwood-7b-q4
```

oncall-bot: Alert: dedicated-pool-novapay p95 > 1s for 3m. Incident opened: INC-2101 :rotating_light:

aj: @sophie @maria can we get heap/cpu profiles + task queue depth from the pool? I can run the perf harness/flamegraph if we have a trace-id or sample traces.

tyler: Deploy tool shows a config change yesterday to that pool: batch_max_tokens bumped 512 -> 1024. That could increase per-request exec time for short, chatty workloads.

sophie: This is customer-impacting. Product needs decision criteria: hotfix rollback vs targeted config override. Suggested launch acceptance for a mitigation: p95 < 300ms for 15m and no error-rate increase.

samir: We can ship a per-customer config override to revert batch_max_tokens to 512 for NovaPayments only. Low-risk and quick. I can prepare a patch to push to their pool.

aj: I'll replicate the change in the perf harness with their request size distribution. If I can reproduce the p95 spike locally we validate quickly. I can own that test.

eva: I'll query telemetry to determine if this spike is isolated to NovaPayments' traffic pattern (many short prompts) or if other customers saw the same after the config change. ETA ~30m.

tyler: If it is batching related, enabling prefix-KV caching for their route might also help reduce exec time for repeated context. Worth exploring as a medium-term fix.

sophie: Product question for backlog: do we create a scoped initiative 'per-customer batching profiles' (higher scope) or treat this as a support-driven one-off config workflow? We need a recommendation for prioritization against existing roadmap items.

maria: Sales notes customer is sensitive to latency regressions and asked for SLA assurance. They may request a formal mitigation timeline and a commit from us. Mark as high-customer-touch.

aj: Proposed triage plan: 1) Samir push config override now (mitigation), 2) Aj run perf harness & confirm repro/fix, 3) Eva confirm telemetry isolation, 4) Sophie decide backlog scope and next steps. I can own #2 and help with rollback plan.

oncall-bot: INC-2101 status update: mitigation in progress.

sophie: I'll convert this thread into a product intake card, link INC-2101 and the support ticket, and update sales. Please drop any logs/traces here. :thumbsup:
